import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create output directory
if not os.path.exists("./submission"):
    os.makedirs("./submission")

# Load Data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify columns
ids = ["id"]
targets = ["target"]
features = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ids + targets]

# Define X, y
X_train = train_df[features].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].copy()
X_test = test_df[features].copy()
X_test_id = test_df["id"]

# Determine categorical columns
cat_features = ["f_27"]
# Other features are numeric (int or float), so no pre-processing needed beyond copying

# Stratified Train/Validation Split (to ensure fair estimate)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Initialize LightGBM Model
# verbose=-1 to hide logs (no progress bars)
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,  # Use all cores
}
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)

# Train model
print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_features)

# Evaluate on Hold-out Validation Set (No Data Leakage)
val_preds_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds_prob)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC Score: {validation_auc:.6f}")

# Generate Predictions on Test Set
print("Generating predictions for test set...")
test_preds_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Prepare Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": X_test_id.values, "target": test_preds_prob})

# Save to required path
output_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
submission.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {output_path}")
